title: decision: packages/vscode-extension (1,513 LOC, 'the official VSCode extension') has no CI build and no vsce/ovsx publish step — build it in CI, or move it out of the monorepo?
body:
Ruled: 6386223367 · letter B · 2026-10-24T15:47Z

Filing gate ②: a decision only the maintainer can make. Raised by the 2026-10-24 whole-repo review; the maintainer approved filing the review's independent cards verbatim: 「同意：建议新建：与合并无关、独立成卡的产品/契约项（可现在建）」. Batch-of: 13.

## 维护者速读

一句话问题：README 称之为「official」的 VS Code 扩展，在本仓没有任何构建或发布门禁，坏了没人知道。1,513 行、private、工作区里没人依赖它、`.github` 里没有 `vsce` / `ovsx`；`ci.yml` 的注释把它列在「闭包之外的 11 个工作区包」里。要么把它接进 turbo/CI 并定义发布路径，要么移出单仓（独立仓或归档）。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384)

- `packages/vscode-extension`: 1,513 non-test lines, 5 source files, last source commit 2026-10-15; `private: true`; no workspace consumer; `rg -l 'vsce|ovsx' .github` → empty (positive control: `pnpm test:e2e` found in `ci.yml`); `package` / `publish` scripts exist in its manifest. Its tsconfig extends neither root config (one of two such packages, per `tsconfig.tier-base.json`'s own header).
- README posture: "The official VSCode extension for Object UI".
- Dedup (`vscode-extension|vsce|ovsx`): 5 hits, 0 open, all incidental (objectui#11519 doc blocks, objectstack-ai/objectui#12415 / objectstack-ai/objectui#12405 test costs, objectstack-ai/objectui#12139 README gate).

## Options × real cost × effort

| | what | what a user sees | effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Add the extension to `turbo run build` and `type-check`, plus a tag-triggered `vsce package` / `ovsx publish` workflow | an extension that is actually released and stays green | M; workflow is a governed surface |
| B | Move it to its own repository (or archive it) and delete the package here | no "official" claim without a release path; one fewer package in the tree | S here, plus a new repo |
| C | Keep as is | a 1.5k-line package that rots silently | 0 |

Business meaning: A is "it is a product, ship it"; B is "it is a side project, do not let it borrow the monorepo's name"; C is "undecided, forever".

四轴：① 长远：A 或 B 都比 C 合理，C 是最差的（声明了但不兑现）；② 业务拉动：没有已知用户（npm / marketplace 安装数未实测）；零拉动默认 B；③ 防 AI 犯错：一个没有门禁的包会被 AI 席位「顺手修」而无法验证；④ 创业阶段不扩散：B 删一个永久义务，A 新增一条发布管线。

Recommendation: **B** unless the maintainer names a user; confidence gap: marketplace install counts are 未实测. Only-① check: 只看①选 A 或 B 均可，②④ 定 B；是否翻转：否（①不分高下）。

裁后执行：A → one PR adding the package to turbo's build/type-check filters and a release workflow (authorised approval needed); B → one PR deleting `packages/vscode-extension`, its README references and the `ci.yml` comment that lists it.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性：A/B 都消除「声明了但不兑现」；C 保留它。
② 实际业务拉动：无已知用户（未实测），零拉动默认 remove。
③ 防 AI 犯错：无门禁的包会被顺手改而无从验证。
④ 创业阶段不扩散：B 删一个永久义务；A 新增一条发布管线。
Prior rulings read: `vscode-extension|vsce|ovsx` → 5 hits (incidental); ADR none; thread: none.
